main_text.l: offerunt, Efræ 7.15. Partic. מִתְנַדֵּב Sponte offerens se, Esr.7.13. Plural. מִתְנַדְּבִים Sponte offerentes, v.16. ⁂ הִתְנַדְּבוּת f. Spontanea oblatio, Esr.7.16.

נָדִיב m. Voluntarius, Spontaneus, Ingenuus, Liberalis, Munificus : Princeps, à Munificentia & Liberalitate dictus, (quò alluditur Luc. 22.25.) Constr. לְנָדִיב Voluntarius animo, 2.Paralip.26.31. Plural. עִם נְדִיבִים Cum principibus, 1.Sam.2.8. Constr. נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים Voluntarii populorum, Psalm.47.10. Fœmin. וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה Et spiritus ingenuus sustentet me: vel juxta alios, Spiritu ingenuitatis sustentato me, Ps.51.14. Aff. נְדִיבָתִי Ingenuitatem meam, vel, Munificam meam, scil. animam, Job.30. v.15. Plural. נְדִיבוֹת Ingenuitates, Res ingenuæ, Munificæ, Jesa.32.8.

Voluntarium, Voluntaria oblatio, Voluntarium sacrificium aut munus: Interdum adverbiascit, pro Sponte, Voluntarie, Benevole, Liberaliter, & tunc ponitur pro בִּנְדָבָה : Constr. נִדְבַת יָדְךָ Voluntaria oblatione manus tuæ, Deut.16.10. Plural. נְדָבוֹת הַשְׁמִיעוּ Indicite sacrificia voluntaria, Amos 4.5. Constr. פִּי נִדְבוֹת Voluntarias oblationes oris mei, Psal.119.108. Aff. נִדְבֹתֵיכֶם Voluntarias oblationes vestras, Lev.23.38.

Vagatus, Evagatus est, Movit sese, Aberravit, Fugit, Profugit: Præterit. נָדְדוּ יַחַד Evagantur pariter, Jesa.22.3. Partic. נֹדֵד Movens sese alà: aut transitivè, Moveat, Agitet alam, quomodo possit esse ex Pihel, Jes.10.14. Plur. נְדֻדִים Errabundi, Hos. 9.17. Fut. יָנוּד Aberret ate, Nah.3.7. Et in Pathach, תָּנוּד Et profugeret, Genes.31.40. Chald. Præter. fœm. נְדְדָה Profugit, Recefsit, Daniel.6.19. Pyh. juxta quos-dam. Præterit. וְנוּדַד Et Movetur, sive Errat, vel Fugit, Nah.
